procedures.name: install-platform
steps: Enable Workers for Platforms, R2 and Analytics Engine in the Cloudflare dashboard
Create an empty dedicated PostgreSQL database (direct or session-mode connection)
Install the CLI (Node 24.22+/26.12+) and run void platform install --plan
Create management and runtime API tokens, R2 keys, login provider credentials; save in a password manager
Run void platform install and apply the saved plan
Sign in as administrator with the one-time /setup code
procedures.destructive: Database is claimed and cannot be swapped; credentials and keys generated only exist in local recovery files unless supplied

procedures.name: resume-interrupted-install
steps: Run void platform install --resume --name <id>
Keep the same --runtime for source builds and the original secrets
Do not start a second installation or regenerate keys
procedures.destructive: Starting a second installation or regenerating keys breaks the saved checkpoint

procedures.name: connect-cli-and-first-deploy
steps: void platform status, void platform auth login, void platform system health
void connect <api-url>
void deploy --platform void --project <name>
procedures.destructive: none

procedures.name: ci-project-deploy-credential
steps: As owner run void project token create --name ci --expires-in 30
Store VOID_TOKEN and VOID_API_URL in the CI secret manager
Run void connect "$VOID_API_URL" --no-login in each fresh CI environment
Set VOID_PROJECT or --project or commit .void/project.json
Behind Access add VOID_ACCESS_CREDENTIALS for API and proxy origins
Rotate with token renew, revoke with token revoke
procedures.destructive: Revoked tokens stop CI deploys; project transfer revokes existing tokens

procedures.name: grant-platform-access
steps: Choose signup mode (invited/allowlist, company-approved, open)
void platform signup allow github|email|identity or void platform invitation send
Confirm the shown change
Inspect with signup show and invitation list
procedures.destructive: signup open lets anyone deploy on the application domain

procedures.name: recover-administrator-login
steps: Have Cloudflare management access, database access and original recovery credentials
Write recovery.json naming administratorUserId (plus configuration for a replacement provider)
void platform config auth recover <connection> --installation <id> --file recovery.json --plan
Complete the real login test and confirm identity
procedures.destructive: Changes who can administer the platform

procedures.name: change-company-access-gate
steps: Use the installing workstation with recovery credentials
Select another admission rule if signup depends on the gate
void platform config auth protection enable|disable --installation <id>
All human sessions end; sign in again
procedures.destructive: Ends all human sessions; removal leaves Cloudflare applications behind

procedures.name: operator-token-in-ci
steps: Set VOID_API_URL explicitly
Pipe VOID_TOKEN full session to void platform auth token --token-stdin into VOID_OPERATOR_TOKEN
unset VOID_TOKEN, run commands, unset VOID_OPERATOR_TOKEN
Repeat after one hour; renew the 30-day session via login
procedures.destructive: Tokens leaked via logs or shell tracing

procedures.name: preview-and-apply-platform-change
steps: Run the command with --plan
Review affected objects
Run with --yes (or confirm interactively)
Check void platform system events
On timeout inspect objects and events before retrying
procedures.destructive: Retrying a timed-out change can repeat partial work

procedures.name: edit-plan-limits
steps: Write plan JSON file
void platform config plans set <id> --file --plan
Review affected accounts and quota warnings
Run with --yes
On pending work run plans show then plans sync --yes
procedures.destructive: Lowering quotas can restrict existing apps

procedures.name: archive-or-remove-plan
steps: Choose another default first
archive --yes or remove --replacement <id> --plan
Review replacement limit changes
Run with --yes
procedures.destructive: Removal moves accounts to the replacement

procedures.name: invite-and-accept-project-member
steps: Owner/admin: void project team invite <email> --role <role>
Invitee: void connect <platform>, void project team pending
void project team accept|decline <invitation-id>
Run void project link in the app directory
procedures.destructive: none

procedures.name: remove-project-member
steps: void project team role|remove|revoke
Wait for credential replacement (about 10 minutes) and check void project status warnings
Deploy trusted code; avoid rollback to the member's deployments
procedures.destructive: Removed member's deployed code keeps running; platform credentials replaced

procedures.name: transfer-project-ownership
steps: Installation admin: void platform project owner <id> <user> --plan
Wait for rollbacks/builds, cancel active deployment, Sandbox cleanup
Run with --yes
Create new CI deploy credentials as the new owner
procedures.destructive: Existing CI deploy credentials revoked; owner usage accounting changes

procedures.name: enable-project-zero-trust
steps: Create Access token and select identity providers and identity Allow policies
printf token | void platform zero-trust configure --identity-providers --policies --existing-projects protected|public [--protect-new-projects] --token-stdin --plan
Run with --yes
void platform zero-trust status [--check]
procedures.destructive: Existing projects become protected or public according to the flag

procedures.name: disable-project-zero-trust
steps: void platform zero-trust disable
Rerun/check status until disabled with no operation
Then uninstall if needed
procedures.destructive: Removes Access applications and makes every project public

procedures.name: recover-zero-trust
steps: Read void platform zero-trust status
Fix cause (token, limit, deleted provider/policy)
void platform zero-trust reconcile (or project reconcile)
If provider/policy deleted: disable then configure again
procedures.destructive: Disable makes projects public

procedures.name: register-email-domain-for-project
steps: void platform email settings-set --domains admin
void platform email domain-add <apex> --project <slug>
Follow DNS steps, domain-status, domain-sync
Rotate with domain-rotate-secret if needed
procedures.destructive: Removal of a domain stops sending

procedures.name: recover-interrupted-email-operations
steps: Inspect attempts or intents (email attempts, shared-recipients)
Confirm original execution ended; wait 24 hours or recovery time
Inspect provider resource; run *-resolve with --plan
Run again without --plan (--yes) with an audit reason free of recipients
procedures.destructive: Wrongly resolving can duplicate or lose provider writes

procedures.name: connected-app-private-preview-and-publish
steps: Register client in Admin and save secret server-side
Sign in with scope=profile preview:deploy
POST /oauth/previews, POST /oauth/preview-deployment-requests, upload, deploy, POST launch
For production publish: prepareDeployArtifact, /oauth/deployment-requests, user approval, deploy with idempotency key
procedures.destructive: Approval permits one deployment that can use the project's existing secrets and run migrations

procedures.name: add-application-domain
steps: void platform domain set <domain> --plan
Grant runtime token Cache Purge on the zone and set a management token
void platform domain set <domain>
Follow nameserver/certificate/Zero Trust guidance and rerun
procedures.destructive: Replacing an application domain is unsupported

procedures.name: enable-project-custom-domains
steps: Install with --dedicated-zone --custom-domains or upgrade --custom-domains
Add SSL and Certificates Edit to the runtime token
Create proxied cname.<application domain> record and enable Cloudflare for SaaS with fallback origin
Owner runs void domain add <hostname> and sets records
procedures.destructive: none

procedures.name: enable-platform-email
steps: Configure Cloudflare Email Routing for the shared sender domain
Add email permissions to the runtime token
Set VOID_EMAIL_SENDER_DOMAIN and VOID_EMAIL_SHARED_ZONE_ID before install or upgrade
void platform upgrade <id>
procedures.destructive: Domain and zone are chosen for the installation lifetime

procedures.name: upgrade-platform
steps: Upgrade the CLI on the admin machine
Add Sandbox permissions to the runtime token if needed
void platform upgrade [id] --plan, then without --plan
If traffic paused: void platform status, fix, run printed resume with same runtime
procedures.destructive: Migrations move forward only; traffic can be paused

procedures.name: rollback-platform
steps: Keep earlier runtime files
void platform rollback [id] --runtime <earlier> [--from-runtime <current>] --plan
Run without --plan
Rerun rotate-proxy-tokens if rolled back far; check AI logging below 1.8.0
procedures.destructive: Migrations are not reversed; rollbacks to 0.26.0 or earlier break app credentials; logging may revert

procedures.name: repair-platform
steps: void platform repair [id] --plan
void platform repair [id]
Restore adopted/external resources and data yourself
procedures.destructive: Repair does not restore data

procedures.name: platform-workers-changed-outside-void
steps: Preview with --plan
Run printed command in a terminal and answer the Replace prompt
Resume automation
procedures.destructive: Accepting removes manually added variables

procedures.name: manage-from-another-machine
steps: void platform discover --account --installation
Provide VOID_PLATFORM_DATABASE_URL and needed secrets
void platform repair if infrastructure is missing
procedures.destructive: none

procedures.name: disaster-recovery-restore
steps: Keep PostgreSQL backup, identity secrets, provider backups and runtime artifacts as one recovery point
Keep traffic disabled and restore data
Supply original identity and keyring, use preserved runtime
discover, repair --plan, review ownership and changes, apply
Enable traffic after verification
procedures.destructive: Restoring over live data; discovery does not recover data

procedures.name: disable-and-enable-platform
steps: void platform disable [id] --plan then apply
CLI deploys and login fail meanwhile; queues retry every five minutes
void platform enable [id] --plan then apply (--runtime for custom builds)
procedures.destructive: Traffic and API rejected while disabled; queue messages may expire

procedures.name: uninstall-platform
steps: void platform zero-trust disable first
Delete projects (for --purge-resources)
void platform uninstall [id] [--purge-data|--purge-resources] --plan then apply
Manual cleanup in documented order if no purge
Delete local record and recovery files; revoke API tokens
procedures.destructive: --purge-resources deletes Workers, Queues, R2 bucket, AI Gateway, DNS, routes, Access resources

procedures.name: deploy-source-built-runtime
steps: vp run build:core
void-dev platform install|upgrade --runtime packages/platform/dist/runtime --plan
Apply without --plan; keep --runtime on resume
CI: discover, upgrade --plan, upgrade --yes with protected secrets
procedures.destructive: Cancelling during migrations can leave the installation waiting for recovery

procedures.name: deploy-github-webhook-ingress
steps: Provision GitHub App and managed-build capability in the fork
Edit wrangler.github-webhook-ingress.jsonc (unique name, API binding, separate hostname)
vp run --filter @voidcloud/api deploy:github-webhook-ingress --env production
Set GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET and GITHUB_WEBHOOK_INGRESS_SECRET on both Workers
Point GitHub App webhook URL to ingress /github and test delivery
procedures.destructive: none

procedures.name: change-platform-schema
steps: Edit platform/packages/api/src/schema.ts
vp run --filter @voidcloud/api db:generate
Review SQL and journal before committing
Add compatibility.json edge only after testing
procedures.destructive: Released migrations are append-only and must stay compatible with previous Workers

procedures.name: run-platform-locally
steps: vp install, vpr install:void-dev
Start PostgreSQL
vp run --filter @voidcloud/api setup --admin-email ...
vp run --filter @voidcloud/api dev:admin
Run dashboard dev in another terminal
procedures.destructive: Tests with VOID_TEST_DATABASE_URL clear tables
